risk_note: RV2 money migration (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator rulings D10-456 ④ and D10-459): one new empty table app.tax_ytd, the yearly withholding ledger of withdrawals (08 BR-WDR-20; 规划/04 §3.2 tax_ytd plus the identity dimension of BR-ID-25 细则「实名更正」): id, app_id, user_id (FK users(app_id, id), NO ACTION), year (the +08:00 year of the withdrawal's created_at, CHECK 2026..2100), income_type (CHECK SERVICE_FEE only; INCIDENTAL is P1), identity_hmac (the member's real-name id_no_hmac at accumulation time, 64 hex, never plaintext), cum_income_fen / cum_withheld_fen (bigint ≥ 0, default 0), continuous_months, created_at / updated_at; unique tax_ytd_identity_key (app_id, user_id, year, income_type, identity_hmac); index (app_id, user_id, year). Grants: couli_app SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE of the three counters and updated_at only; couli_payout and couli_readonly SELECT; no DELETE / TRUNCATE for any role. tax_ytd joins tools/ci/lint-migrations.ts FUNDS_TABLE_NAMES (no prefix matches tax_), so the funds-table rules guard it from now on (a tools/** gate change the orchestrator labels). db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts regenerated by pnpm db:snapshot on the test machine. No data, no code path and no money movement change in this task; the accumulation is B2-08b, the tax calculation B2-08c, the export port B2-08d. The migration file is 0103_tax-ytd.sql: it was drafted as 0102, and renumbered at landing per D10-116 after B1-15zb #1944 took 0102 (orchestrator 10-31 05:4x / 07:1x migration-slot order).
